description: Kuribayashi于1974年推出的旁轴相机。配备45mm (f/1.8 or 2.8) amber-coated lens. 52mm filter thread.。快门速度Petri XV shutter with speeds: B up to 1/500. Self cocking, X synchronization, built-in self-timer, release pressure 200g.。使用35mm film (meter can be set to ASA 10 - 400)。Coupled rangefinder, focusing from 0.8 m (2.75ft) to infinity. "Green-O-Matic" (on the f/1.8 model)。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm film (meter can be set to ASA 10 - 400)
specs.快门: Petri XV shutter with speeds: B up to 1/500. Self cocking, X synchronization, built-in self-timer, release pressure 200g.
specs.取景器: Bright-line type with parallax correction mark
specs.对焦: Coupled rangefinder, focusing from 0.8 m (2.75ft) to infinity. "Green-O-Matic" (on the f/1.8 model)
specs.曝光测光: 'Circle-Eye' selenium exposure meter, reading EV7 - 17 at 100 ASA. 'Zero Method' (i.e. match-needle); displays in the viewfinder and on the top plate.
specs.闪光灯: Hot shoe and PC socket. Electronic flash synchronisation with all shutter speeds.
specs.英文简介: The Petri 7s II is a fixed-lens 35mm rangefinder camera introduced by Petri in 1974.
